claims: Sean Penn won the Academy Award for Best Supporting Actor at the 2026 Oscars for his role in One Battle After Another.
Sean Penn has three career Oscar wins.
Sean Penn's 2026 Oscar win is his first in the supporting category.
Sean Penn has previous Oscar wins for lead actor.
The 2026 Oscars took place on March 15, 2026.
Benicio Del Toro was nominated for Best Supporting Actor at the 2026 Oscars for One Battle After Another.
Jacob Elordi was nominated for Best Supporting Actor at the 2026 Oscars for Frankenstein.
Delroy Lindo was nominated for Best Supporting Actor at the 2026 Oscars for Sinners.
Stellan Skarsgård was nominated for Best Supporting Actor at the 2026 Oscars for Sentimental Value.
Sean Penn was not in attendance to accept the award at the 2026 Oscars.
Paul Thomas Anderson is the director of One Battle After Another.
Paul Thomas Anderson won Best Picture at the 98th Academy Awards.
Paul Thomas Anderson won Adapted Screenplay at the 98th Academy Awards.
The 2026 Oscars are the 98th Academy Awards
